There I see strange white but that my envs.net account is inside. when I try to delete the room via the api I get the following: ``` curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" "https://matrix.envs.net/_synapse/admin/v1/rooms/\!UGYpXmlyESJlkXkarj:matrix.org/delete" --data '{ "new_room_user_id": "@notices:envs.net", "room_name": "Content Violation Notification", "message": "Bad Room has been shutdown due to content violations on this server. Please review our Terms of Service.", "block": false, "purge": true, "force-purge": true }'"" ``` ``` {"errcode":"M_NOT_FOUND","error":"Unknown room id !UGYpXmlyESJlkXkarj:matrix.org"} ``` Is there any idea what I can do to fix this problem please? **[full homeserver.log](https://envs.sh/Sm.txt)** **[unknown room_id summary](https://envs.sh/SO.txt)** ### Version information - **Homeserver**: envs.net - **Version**: Synapse 1.24.0 - **Install method**: package manager (apt) matrix-synapse-py3 - **Platform**: Debian 10 (buster) on AMD Ryzen 7 3700X with 64GB RAM and 2x1TB SSD m.2
